verdict.rationale: stagewise has a cloud and managed-inference layer, so a published API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and the llms.txt file is a documentation index rather than a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
